summary: Phase 2 UI testing of 'The Fittest' completed successfully. Admin tabs (Overview, Challenges, Feed, Ranking, Engagement, Reports, Settings) all render. Ranking: 16 athletes with adjust buttons; Export CSV downloads 'the_fittest_The_Fittest_Camp_Challenge.csv'. Adjust +3 on Lucas -> toast 'Adjusted. Lucas Silva now has 3 pts'; then -1 -> 'now has 2 pts' (both persisted in ranking, Overview Top10 and athlete leaderboard). Engagement tab shows totals cards (Posts/Comments/Reactions), 14-day chart (08-26..09-08), Top posters, No posts yet list (all 16 athletes), and Participation by team section. Settings tab: all six controls present (setting-enabled, setting-require-photo, setting-watermark, setting-gallery, setting-camera, setting-badge-type). Toggling watermark shows 'Settings updated' toast; state persists after full reload; reverted to original. Enabled left ON. Athlete side: winner-banner appears for both Pedro ('Lucas Silva Men took the crown') and Lucas ('You won! Congratulations!'); dismiss-winner-btn hides banner and stays hidden on reload (localStorage). Watermark: uploaded 800x600 solid-color JPG as Lucas, image served at 800x600 with 1024 unique colors in bottom-right 200x80 region (confirms watermark rendered). Regression: feed loads, posts render, leaderboard shows 16 athletes with combined ranking including latest points from admin adjustments + training check-in.

issues: Recharts prints repeated 'width(-1) height(-1)' console warnings during initial mount; cosmetic but noisy.

critical_code_review_comments: Note: task spec referenced 'admin-tab-reports' but implementation uses 'admin-tab-reported' data-testid. Both are consistent; no action needed unless main agent wants naming alignment.
Recharts console spam on Overview/Engagement due to container width(-1) at first paint; consider setting minWidth/minHeight or delaying mount to remove noise.
seed_data_creation: Adjusted Lucas Silva points +3 then -1 (net +2) with reasons 'Test +3'/'Test -1'. Published one Lucas training check-in post (blue 800x600 JPG). Setting 'watermark' toggled off then back on. Enabled left ON as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 2 flows verified via UI. Lucas Silva now has +2 admin-adjusted pts and 1 training post (total 3 pts) in 'The Fittest Camp Challenge'. Winner banner works for both winner and non-winner athletes. Watermark render confirmed by pixel-diversity in bottom-right region of served photo.
